ideas.title: The Minnesota Child Care Fraud Scandal: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's child care programs, including the large-scale scheme involving fake child care centers.
ideas.angle: The story would focus on the impact of the fraud on families and child care providers, as well as the efforts of the Trump administration to address the issue.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
How will the freeze on funds affect families and child care providers?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota child care fraud scandal has significant implications for the state's families and child care providers. The story should focus on the facts of the case and the impact on those affected.
